name: Empty Leaden Collection Phial
summary: Ozzie Togglevolt gathers Gnomeregan’s radioactive fallout in a leaden phial. He hopes the residue may help cure his afflicted kin, or make an extraordinarily potent drink.

sections.title: A Shielded Vessel
sections.body:
Ozzie Togglevolt made a leaden phial to gather the radiation left in Gnomeregan. The city’s vents once flooded its tunnels with toxic radiation to purge the trogg menace. The surviving defenders became leper gnomes, and the invading beasts were irradiated.

Green light still clings to Irradiated Invaders and Pillagers prowling the ruins. The lead shields the handler as the phial draws in the dangerous residue. Once sealed, the collection becomes a Full Leaden Collection Phial for Ozzie’s experiments.

faq.q: What is the phial used for?
aliases: how to use empty leaden collection phial
faq.answer: The phial gathers radioactive fallout from Irradiated Invaders and Irradiated Pillagers near Gnomeregan’s surface tunnels. Sealed inside, the collection becomes a Full Leaden Collection Phial for research.

faq.q: Why is the phial made of lead?
faq.answer: The lead shields the handler from Gnomeregan’s lethal radioactive fallout. Without protection, living beings can suffer severe radiation sickness, and gnomes can become lepers.
Ozzie Togglevolt, a gnome tinkerer, made the phial. He works from Kharanos in Dun Morogh and gives it to those willing to brave Gnomeregan’s toxic outskirts.

faq.q: What does Ozzie hope to achieve with the collected fallout?
faq.answer: Ozzie and his associate Razzle hope the collected fallout will help them invent a cure for leper gnomes afflicted by the catastrophe. Ozzie also allows that their formula might become potent rum or a cure for baldness.

angles.text: For exiled gnomes, Gnomeregan’s ruin remains an open wound. Any attempt to reverse its toxic fallout carries personal stakes, however eccentric the researcher.
The leaden phial pairs heavy metal shielding with suction apparatus to collect volatile environmental particles safely. It is a practical piece of gnomish engineering.
